problem_statement: Enterprise LLM agents fail in production >45% of the time due to non-deterministic loops, context window bloat, and uncontrolled third-party API hallucination.
solution_statement: A lightweight runtime observability SDK that intercepts agent tool calls in under 12ms, tracks execution trees, and automatically rolls back corrupted database state.
